daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only buying a stock when several independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD crossover, price versus moving average, and volume — all point the same bullish direction at once. This reduces the chance of chasing a random price spike and increases confidence that real buying interest (often institutional) is behind the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指只有在多個獨立技術指標(例如RSI、MACD黃金交叉、股價與均線關係,以及成交量)同時發出看漲訊號時才買入。這樣可以減少追逐隨機價格波動的風險,並提高信心,確認背後有真實(通常是機構)買盤支持。
